tool_schemas.name: get_tweets_by_userid
tool_schemas.description: Returns a page of tweets authored by the specified user, optionally including replies and/or quote tweets, filtered by lifecycle status and sorted by created time; results are paged with an opaque cursor and a limit (1–100). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_id is malformed, limit is out of range, or an unsupported filter/sort is provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if the author user does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view the user’s tweets.

user_id.description: Author user id to fetch tweets for (users.id).

include_replies.description: Whether to include tweets that are replies.

include_quotes.description: Whether to include tweets that quote other tweets.

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_tweet_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tweet by id and returns its stored fields; when include_entities is true, the response also includes parsed entities (mentions/hashtags/urls) extracted from the tweet text. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tweet_id is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the tweet does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the tweet exists but is not visible to the caller due to its lifecycle/visibility rules (e.g., hidden).

include_entities.description: Whether to include parsed tweet entities (mentions/hashtags/urls).

tool_schemas.name: get_user_mentions
tool_schemas.description: Returns a page of tweets that mention the specified user, filtered by mentioned-tweet lifecycle status and sorted by created time; results are paged with an opaque cursor and a limit (1–100). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if user_id is malformed, limit is out of range, or an unsupported filter/sort is provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if the user does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view mentions for that user.

user_id.description: User id whose mentions should be returned (users.id).

status.description: Filter by mentioned tweet lifecycle status.

sort.description: Sort order for returned mention tweets.

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: quote_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new published tweet authored by author_user_id that quotes quote_of_tweet_id, and returns the newly created tweet record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed, text is empty/over 280 chars, or other fields fail validation. Raises NOT_FOUND if the author user or quoted tweet does not exist, and CONFLICT/FORBIDDEN if the quoted tweet cannot be quoted due to its current lifecycle/visibility (e.g., deleted or hidden).

author_user_id.description: User id of the quoting author (users.id).

text.description: Text content of the quote tweet.

lang.description: Optional BCP-47 language code for the tweet.

source.description: Client/source label used to create the tweet.

tool_schemas.name: reply_to_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new published tweet authored by author_user_id as a reply to reply_to_tweet_id, and returns the newly created tweet record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed, text is empty/over 280 chars, or other fields fail validation. Raises NOT_FOUND if the author user or parent tweet does not exist, and CONFLICT/FORBIDDEN if the parent tweet cannot be replied to due to its current lifecycle/visibility (e.g., deleted or hidden).

author_user_id.description: User id of the replying author (users.id).

text.description: Text content of the reply tweet.

lang.description: Optional BCP-47 language code for the tweet.

source.description: Client/source label used to create the tweet.

tool_schemas.name: post_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new published tweet for the given author and returns the created tweet record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if author_user_id is malformed, text is empty/over 280 chars, or optional fields fail validation. Raises NOT_FOUND if the author user does not exist, and FORBIDDEN/QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller is not allowed to post or has exceeded posting limits.

author_user_id.description: User id of the author posting the tweet (users.id).

lang.description: Optional BCP-47 language code for the tweet.

source.description: Client/source label used to create the tweet.

tool_schemas.name: like_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Registers a like by actor_user_id on tweet_id and returns the resulting like state (or the updated tweet/like summary, depending on the backend configuration). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the actor user or tweet does not exist, and CONFLICT if the actor has already liked the tweet or the tweet is not likeable due to its lifecycle/visibility (e.g., deleted/hidden).

tool_schemas.name: follow_user
tool_schemas.description: Creates a follow edge from actor_user_id to target_user_id and returns the resulting relationship state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed or actor_user_id equals target_user_id. Raises NOT_FOUND if either user does not exist, and CONFLICT if the follow relationship already exists or the follow is not allowed by policy (authorization/visibility constraints).

tool_schemas.name: unfollow_user
tool_schemas.description: Removes the follow edge from actor_user_id to target_user_id and returns the resulting relationship state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed or actor_user_id equals target_user_id. Raises NOT_FOUND if either user does not exist, and CONFLICT if no follow relationship exists to remove or the operation is not permitted by authorization rules.

actor_user_id.description: ID of the user performing the unfollow (users.id).

target_user_id.description: ID of the user being unfollowed (users.id).

tool_schemas.name: get_user_by_username
tool_schemas.description: Looks up and returns a user by username using a case-insensitive match against the stored normalized_username. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if username is empty or fails validation. Raises NOT_FOUND if no user matches the provided username, and FORBIDDEN if the matched user is not visible to the caller.

username.description: Username to look up (case-insensitive match against normalized_username).

tool_schemas.name: search_tweets
tool_schemas.description: Searches tweet text for the given free-text query and returns a paged list of matching tweets, optionally filtered by author_user_id, lang, and lifecycle status, sorted by the requested created_at order. Results are returned up to limit with an opaque cursor; pass the cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty, IDs/cursor are malformed, or limit/sort/status are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if author_user_id is provided but no such user exists; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not allowed to view tweets with the requested status (for example hidden).

query.description: Free-text search query applied to tweet text.

author_user_id.description: If provided, restrict results to tweets authored by this user (tweets.author_user_id).

lang.description: If provided, restrict results to tweets in this language code (tweets.lang).

status.description: If provided, restrict results to tweets in this lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of tweets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_trending_topics
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current trending topics, optionally restricted to a language code, as a list capped by limit. This endpoint is not paginated; it returns at most limit topics in a single response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if lang is empty/invalid or limit is out of range, and raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

lang.description: If provided, restrict trending topics to a language code.

limit.description: Maximum number of trending topics to return.

tool_schemas.name: create_list
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new user-curated list owned by owner_user_id with the provided name, optional description, and visibility, and returns the created list record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty, visibility is not one of the allowed values, or IDs are malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND if owner_user_id does not exist, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot create lists on behalf of that owner.

owner_user_id.description: ID of the user who will own the list (lists.owner_user_id).

tool_schemas.name: add_list_member
tool_schemas.description: Adds member_user_id to the specified list and returns the resulting list membership record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any ID is malformed or required fields are missing. Raises NOT_FOUND if the list_id, member_user_id, or added_by_user_id do not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if added_by_user_id is not permitted to modify the list (for example, not the list owner for a private list); raises CONFLICT if the user is already a member or the list is not in an active state that accepts membership changes.

list_id.description: ID of the list to add a member to (lists.id).

member_user_id.description: ID of the user being added to the list (users.id).

added_by_user_id.description: ID of the user performing the add (list_members.added_by_user_id).

tool_schemas.name: remove_list_member
tool_schemas.description: Removes member_user_id from the specified list and returns a confirmation of the removal. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any ID is malformed or required fields are missing. Raises NOT_FOUND if the list_id, member_user_id, or removed_by_user_id do not exist, or if the specified membership does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if removed_by_user_id is not permitted to modify the list; raises CONFLICT if the list is not in an active state that allows membership changes.

list_id.description: ID of the list to remove a member from (lists.id).

member_user_id.description: ID of the user being removed from the list (users.id).

removed_by_user_id.description: ID of the user performing the removal (auditing convenience for the action).

tool_schemas.name: get_owned_lists
tool_schemas.description: Lists the lists owned by owner_user_id and returns a paged result set, optionally filtered by list status and visibility and sorted by the requested created_at/updated_at order. Results are returned up to limit with an opaque cursor; pass the cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs/cursor are malformed or limit/sort/status/visibility are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if owner_user_id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED when requesting lists the caller is not allowed to view (for example private lists owned by another user).

owner_user_id.description: ID of the user whose owned lists to return (lists.owner_user_id).

status.description: If provided, restrict results to lists in this lifecycle status.

visibility.description: If provided, restrict results to lists with this visibility.

limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of lists.

metadata.name: X V2 MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend models a minimal but production-plausible X/Twitter-like service facade used by an MCP server: users, tweets (including replies and quotes), social graph (follows), likes, and user-curated lists. It supports read workflows (fetch tweets, mentions, trending, search, lists) and write work
